# How to Calculate the Jacobian for Any Point on a Robotic Arm's Link That Is Not Already in the Model?

> **Current answer:** The project contributor suggests adding the point using model.addFrame(Frame(name, joint_support_id, 0, placement)), followed by the Frame Jacobian path; where 'placement' is relative to the parent joint frame. When the target point changes in real-time, it is necessary to explicitly update model.frames[your_frame_id].placement. The original author did not provide numerical validation, so this is a method confirmed by the project contributor but still requires limited difference validation in the target model.

## Effective fixes

- Add a frame with the supporting joint as the parent node; placement is relative to the parent joint frame, and the frame Jacobian is calculated via the frame Jacobian path.
- Update the corresponding frame's placement when the target point's position changes.
